t: The value of the integral ∫_a^b (|x|)/xdx, where a<b is
s:
Three cases may arise
Case (i) : let 0≤a<b, then (|x|)/x=x/x=1
∴∫_a^b (|x|)/xdx=∫_a^b dx=b−a=|b|−|a|
(Since |a|=a and |b|=b )
Case (ii) : Let a<b≤0, then (|x|)/x=(−x)/x=−1
∫_a^b (|x|)/xdx=∫_a^b (−1)dx=a−b=−|a|+|b|
(Since |a|=−a and |b|=−b )
Case (iii) : Let  a<0<b, then ∫_a^b (|x|)/xdx=∫_a^0 (|x|)/xdx+∫_0^b (|x|)/xdx
=∫_a^0 (−1)dx=∫_0^b (1)dx=a+b=−|a|+∣b
( Since |a|=−a and |b|=b) Thus, in every case ∫_a^b (|x|)/xdx=|b|−|a|
